rules.prepare:
cd "$AELTRA_SOURCE_DIR"
# As in Debian, whose sources come without zlib and popt: config.status # expects the two folders. mkdir -p zlib popt touch zlib/dummy.in popt/dummy.in
bh_autotools_dev_update autoreconf -vfi
# rrsync is a Python script for /usr/bin/python3. EXTRA_OPTS="" if [ "$AELTRA_BUILD_FOR" = "target" ]; then EXTRA_OPTS="--with-rrsync" fi
# Built in the source folder, as in Debian: the Makefile runs autoconf where # it is. cd "$AELTRA_BUILD_DIR" "$AELTRA_SOURCE_DIR/configure" \ --prefix="$AELTRA_INSTALL_PREFIX" \ --build="$AELTRA_HOST_TYPE" \ --host="$AELTRA_HOST_TYPE" \ --with-included-zlib=no \ --with-included-popt=no \ --disable-md5-asm \ --disable-md2man \ $EXTRA_OPTS
